name: تحديد متى يمكن للعميل استئجار سيارة (الحالة 2)
description: إنشاء برنامج يحدد ما إذا كان العميل يستطيع استئجار سيارة بناءً على المدخلات التي يتلقاها من وكيل تأجير السيارات. سيارات الإيجار متاحة للسائقين المرخصين الذين تبلغ أعمارهم 21 سنة أو أكثر والذين لم يتعرضوا لحادث.
code:
#Khatwa 1: qiraat al-madkhal li-umr al-ameel
text = input("Adkhil umr al-ameel:")
age = int(text)
#Khatwa 2: qiraat al-madkhal litaqdeer idha kana al-ameel ladayh rukhsat sayyarah
text = input("Adkhil 1 itha kana al-ameel ladayh rukhsat sayyarah, wa illa adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 3: tahdeed idha kana al-ameel ladayh rukhsat sayyarah
if input_num == 1 :
    has_license = True
else:
    has_license = False
#Khatwa 4: qiraat al-madkhal litaqdeer idha kana al-ameel qad taarrad li-haadeth
text = input("Adkhil 1 itha kana al-ameel qad taarrad li-haadeth, wa illa adkhil 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Khatwa 5: tahdeed idha kana al-ameel qad taarrad li-haadeth
if input_num == 1 :
    had_accidents = True
else:
    had_accidents = False
#Khatwa 6: kitabah taebir booli litaqdeer idha kan al-ameel yastatiiu isti'jar sayyarah
can_rent_car = age >= 21 and has_license and not had_accidents
#Khatwa 7: tabea al-nateejah
if can_rent_car == True :
    print("Na'am! al-ameel yumkinuhu isti'jar sayyarah.")
else:
    print("La! al-ameel la yumkinuhu isti'jar sayyarah.")

يمكننا اختبار أن العميل لم يتعرض لحادث عن طريق عكس الشرط الذي يختبر ما إذا كان العميل قد تعرض لحادث باستخدام العامل not.
لاحظ أن العامل and يُنتج القيمة True إذا كانت كل الشروط True. كما أن العامل not يأخذ شرطاً واحداً ويُقيّمه إلى True إذا كان ذلك الشرط False وإلى False إذا كان الشرط True.

untr_comments.content: We need three conditions to determine whether the customer could rent a car. We use the and operator to combine these conditions. The first condition is to test if the customer is 21 years of age or older, the second condition is to test if the customer has driver's license, and the third condition is to test if the customer has not had an accident.
We could check whether the customer has not had an accident by inverting the condition that tests whether the customer has had an accident. We invert the condition by using not operator.

Note that the and operator yields the result True if both conditions are True. Also note that the not operator takes a single condition and evaluates to True if that condition is False and to False if the condition is True.

untr_name: Determining When a Customer Could Rent a Car (Case 2)
untr_description: Construct a program that determines whether a customer could rent a car based on the inputs that it receives from the car rental agent. Rental cars are available to licensed drivers of 21 years of age or over who have not had a car accident.
untr_code:
#Step 1: Read the input for the customer's age 
text = input("Enter the customer's age:")
age = int(text)
#Step 2: Read the input for determining whether the customer has driver's license
text = input("Enter 1 if the customer has driver's license, otherwise enter 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Step 3: Determine whether the customer has driver's license
if input_num == 1 :
    has_license = True
else:
    has_license = False
#Step 4: Read the input for determining whether the customer has had an accident
text = input("Enter 1 if the customer has had an accident, otherwise enter 0:")
input_num = int(text)
#Step 5: Determine whether the customer has had an accident
if input_num == 1 :
    had_accidents = True
else:
    had_accidents = False
#Step 6: Write the boolean expression to determine whether a customer could rent a car
can_rent_car = age >= 21 and has_license and not had_accidents
#Step 7: Print the result
if can_rent_car == True :
    print("Yes! The customer could rent a car.")
else:
    print("No! The customer could not rent a car.")
